INVESTOR RELATIONS

CORPORATE GOVERNANCE

DarGlobal PLC is an international real estate developer specializing in exclusive luxury developments across the world’s most coveted cosmopolitan cities.

Catering to global citizens seeking prime investments, second homes, and luxury living, DarGlobal transforms real estate into economic catalysts, unlocking opportunities for both investors and the countries it enters.

DarGlobal has partnered with over 11 world-renowned luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. These collaborations offer unique investment opportunities in global cities, providing both wealth growth and protection.

Listed on the London Stock Exchange, DarGlobal goes beyond property development; it drives economic transformation by attracting international clients and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI). With a presence in 13 international cities across 8 countries, DarGlobal’s portfolio spans the United Kingdom, Spain, Greece, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, the United States, and Qatar. The company is also expanding into world-class hospitality, developing luxury hotels in Dubai, Muscat, Riyadh and Jeddah. To support its international clientele, DarGlobal has sales and customer service offices in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha.

LEADERS IN REAL ESTATE

Listed on the London Stock Exchange since 2023, we’re building on three decades of development know-how. Every opportunity is strategically curated and backed by market insight. Our partners represent forward-thinking luxury brands who share our passion for design: Aston Martin, W Hotels, Missoni, Automobili Lamborghini, to name a few.

From London to Dubai, our portfolio spans 14 cities and 9 countries, offering prime access to the world’s most dynamic markets. We serve our international clientele from hubs in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha.

As DarGlobal’s CEO, Ziad El Chaar leads the company’s strategic expansion and partnerships. Under his stewardship, DarGlobal was listed on the London Stock Exchange in 2023 and has forged exclusive collaborations with likeminded luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. El Chaar has pioneered DarGlobal’s diversification into the hospitality sector, while also overseeing innovative development projects across key markets in the UAE, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain and UK.

documents.content:
EXPAND YOUR WORLD.

DarGlobal develops premium real estate for global citizens who seek elevated living and enduring value. From branded residences to resort-style retreats, every project offers luxurious design and real-life amenities. All in coveted locations with smart investment potential.

SECURE YOUR FUTURE

Investing in real estate unlocks more than a home. Discover the freedom to live anywhere. Tax benefits. Long-term stability. Strategic investment opens doors to new possibilities.

SAUDI ARABIA: RESIDENCY THROUGH INVESTMENT

Invest 4M SAR (Approx 1.07M USD) to secure Saudi residency and its exclusive benefits.

Enjoy a 30-year corporate tax exemption, ensuring long-term financial advantages.

The Saudi Riyal (SAR) is pegged to USD, offering currency stability for investors.

Investors can now open a bank account in Saudi Arabia while on a visit visa.

OMAN: LIFETIME RESIDENCY FOR INVESTORS

Invest in real estate and obtain lifetime residency.

Hassle-free bank account setup for investors.

0% Personal income tax ensures greater financial gains.

0% Import or export duties, making business operations seamless.

QATAR: A GATEWAY TO PROSPERITY

No personal income tax and no property tax, maximizing returns. Competitive corporate tax rates make Qatar an attractive business hub.

Permanent Residency

Obtain permanent residency by investing 3,650,000 QAR (1 million USD), providing long-term residency and access to Qatar’s benefits.

Investor Visa Program

Offers residency to investors who purchase real estate in Qatar with a minimum investment of 728,000 QAR (200,000 USD). Upon confirmation of payment, the Ministry of Justice issues a Sanad Mabdayi, a temporary title deed recognizing ownership. This enables investors to apply for residency even before project completion, under the new government-approved framework.

UNITED ARAB EMIRATES (UAE): 10-YEAR GOLDEN VISA

in real estate, now including off-plan properties, to obtain a 10-year Golden Visa.

DarGlobal is evolving how the world invests in luxury real estate. Through blockchain-powered tokenization, we’re making access to high-value properties smarter, more flexible, and globally connected.

WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR YOU?

We’re turning physical assets into digital tokens - fractional shares of our premium properties that investors can buy, sell, or hold. This opens the door to new opportunities:

Invest in DarGlobal’s most exclusive projects from anywhere in the world.

Liquidity with Confidence

Trade your tokens through regulated platforms while knowing you’re backed by real-world assets.

Security & Transparency

Every transaction is recorded on a secure blockchain, ensuring full visibility and trust.

Fractional Ownership

Own a share of luxury residences without the complexity of traditional real estate deals.

WHY TOKENIZATION WITH DARGLOBAL?

We deliver real investments with real returns. Tokenization is a new key unlocking smarter, more agile ownership models:

IT’S NOT ABOUT TRENDS, IT’S ABOUT EXPANDING YOUR PORTFOLIO.

IT’S NOT ABOUT CRYPTO HYPE, IT’S ABOUT ENHANCING LIQUIDITY.

IT’S NOT ABOUT MAKING NOISE, IT’S ABOUT GIVING GLOBAL CITIZENS MORE CONTROL.

WITH TOKENIZATION, DARGLOBAL IS FUTURE-PROOFING REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT FOR DISCERNING INVESTORS. THIS IS HOW YOU INVEST DIFFERENTLY.

documents.content:
Summary: Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months

Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln

Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million). The performance was driven by the Group’s projects and sustained demand across its diversified portfolio in the GCC, Europe, and the UK.

Gross profit for the period rose 85% to US$87.7 million, expanding margins to 34% (from 31%). EBITDA increased 73% to US$46.3 million, while net profit surged 149% to US$30.4 million (HY 2025: US$12.2 million). Growth was primarily anchored by revenue recognition from landmark projects, including The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin and Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad.

The Group’s Gross Development Value (GDV) nearly doubled year-on-year to reach US$23.0 billion, reflecting rapid portfolio expansion. Cumulative contracted sales rose to US$3.9 billion across 4,380 units. Dar Global maintained a robust balance sheet with a Net Asset Value of US$613.3 million and total cash balances of US$847.9 million (comprising US$231.6 million free cash and US$616.3 million restricted escrow), supporting total available liquidity of US$579.3 million.

Operational momentum accelerated in Saudi Arabia with major project launches. In January, the Group partnered with The Trump Organization to launch Rayana, a 2.6 million sq. m gated community in Diriyah featuring luxury mansions and a championship golf course, followed by a SAR 338 million (~US$90 million) infrastructure contract award to Compass and Bin Omairah Company. Dar Global also unveiled Trump Plaza Jeddah (GDV US$383.6 million) and the adjacent Padel Living Residences (GDV US$142 million) within the Amaya masterplan.

Capital management and project execution remained key focus areas. In April, the Group strengthened its financial flexibility by closing a US$250 million syndicated term loan facility. Following the period in August, Dar Global appointed Gulf Asia Contracting to execute podium construction for the 80-storey, ~350-metre Trump International Hotel & Tower on Dubai's Sheikh Zayed Road.

Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive, commented: “We have delivered a resilient performance through uncertain times in the region, supported by the quality of our international portfolio. Buyer demand across our markets remained robust, with cumulative contracted sales at 30 June 2026 of c. US$3.9 billion (Dec 2025 c. US$ 3.2 billion). During the period we closed our US$250 million facility, further strengthening our balance sheet and liquidity. Looking ahead, we remain focused on growing our Gross Development Value across both existing and new growth markets, while maintaining a disciplined focus on execution and delivery. With a strong balance sheet, disciplined capital management and a healthy project pipeline, Dar Global is well positioned to continue creating long-term value for its stakeholders.”
